functionalRequirement: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support opening at least 5 different types of bank accounts with all standard required fields for each account type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive coverage of account types mentioned in the functional requirement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for account creation, including government-issued ID verification and biometric or two-factor authentication.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects against fraudulent account openings and ensures secure account creation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide real-time validation for all account opening fields, with clear error messages for incorrect or incomplete information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users complete account creation process accurately and efficiently.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The account opening system must have 99.99% uptime during business hours (8 AM to 8 PM, 7 days a week).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can open accounts consistently without service interruptions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The entire account creation process must be completed within 10 minutes, with each validation step taking no more than 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a quick and responsive account opening experience for users.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to add expenses with details including amount, date, payer, and optional split among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately calculate expense splits with 100% mathematical precision, supporting up to 10 participants per expense.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accurate financial calculations for expense tracking.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Expense entry and split calculation must be completed within 500 milliseconds for single entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides responsive expense tracking with minimal user waiting time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All expense data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption and transmitted using TLS 1.3 protocol.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive financial information from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide inline tooltips and auto-complete suggestions for common expense categories and payer names.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies expense entry process and reduces user input errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must implement automatic backup of expense data every 5 minutes and support full data restoration within 15 minutes in case of system failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures no loss of critical financial tracking information.

functionalRequirement: Faculties shall be able to upload and download assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: File uploads and downloads must complete within 30 seconds for files up to 500 MB, with bandwidth support of at least 10 Mbps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient handling of various document and media types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support file uploads and downloads for at least 20 different file formats including .docx, .pdf, .jpg, .mp4, .xlsx, and .ppt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility for different types of academic documents and media.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement role-based access control ensuring only authorized faculty members can upload or download specific types of documents.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive academic materials from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide file type and size validation with clear error messages, preventing uploads of unsupported or oversized files.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users to upload appropriate files and prevents system overload.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.95% uptime for document management system during academic working hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to critical academic resources.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow users to rate and review services by providing comments on tour plans or services, with comments stored in the database and a thank you message displayed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: Support rating system with 5-star scale and ability to submit text comments of up to 500 characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides comprehensive feedback mechanism for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement content filtering to prevent offensive or inappropriate comments before database storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures clean and appropriate user-generated content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Comment submission and thank you message display must occur within 200 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides immediate feedback to enhance user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: Provide optional fields for detailed feedback and suggestions to improve services.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Encourages more comprehensive user input and service improvement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: Implement automatic backup of all user reviews and ratings every hour, with ability to restore within 10 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures preservation of valuable user feedback data.

functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The search functionality must support 100% of product types in the database, including exact and partial name matches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive search capability for all products in the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Search results must be returned within 500 milliseconds for databases containing up to 100,000 product entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides quick response times for user product searches to maintain a smooth user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The search function must provide autocorrect suggestions for misspelled product names and handle case-insensitive searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users find products even with minor input errors or variations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The search interface must display clear error messages if no products are found, with suggestions for alternative search terms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users when their initial search does not yield results.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Search queries and product view history must be encrypted and not stored longer than 30 days.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user search privacy and prevents unauthorized tracking of search behaviors.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The doctor suggestion algorithm must match symptoms/diseases to specialties with 95% accuracy based on medical knowledge databases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures reliable and medically appropriate doctor recommendations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Doctor recommendations must be generated within 2 seconds of symptom input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides quick response for users seeking medical consultation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The doctor suggestion system must be operational 99.9% of the time, with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for providing consistent medical consultation support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All symptom and disease information must be encrypted using HIPAA-compliant encryption standards during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive medical information and ensures patient privacy.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide clear explanations for doctor recommendations, including specialty relevance and matching criteria.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users understand the basis of doctor suggestions.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to choose payment methods such as PayPal balance, debit or credit card, and transfer funds by entering recipient's email ID or name, and making the payment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all specified payment methods (PayPal, debit card, credit card) with full transaction capabilities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can use their preferred payment method.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement PCI DSS Level 1 compliance for all payment transactions, with real-time fraud detection algorithms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects financial transactions from unauthorized access or manipulation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication for all fund transfer operations, including one-time PIN or biometric verification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures that only authorized users can perform financial transactions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Complete payment processing and fund transfer within 3 seconds for 99% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides quick and responsive payment experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: Implement automatic transaction rollback mechanism if any payment step fails, with comprehensive error logging.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents partial or failed transactions and ensures financial data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide real-time validation for recipient email/name and payment method before transaction confirmation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents user errors during fund transfer process.

functionalRequirement: System shall automatically update the available quantity of each medicine after a sale is completed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: Inventory quantity must be updated with 100% accuracy immediately after each sale transaction.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise tracking of medicine inventory levels.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Inventory update must be completed within 100 milliseconds of sale transaction completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides real-time inventory tracking with minimal system overhead.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Inventory management system must maintain 99.99% uptime with automatic data synchronization.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining accurate stock levels across sales channels.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: Implement a separate, loosely coupled inventory management module that can be independently updated or replaced.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for future enhancements or modifications to inventory tracking system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement audit logging for all inventory updates with immutable transaction records.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides traceability and prevents unauthorized inventory manipulations.

functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The calendar view must load and update available appointment slots within 2 seconds for each healthcare provider, supporting real-time availability tracking.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick loading of appointment slots is crucial for user experience and efficient scheduling.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Interface Clarity: The calendar view must be intuitive, with color-coded availability status, clear time slots, and responsive design compatible with desktop and mobile devices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures easy interpretation of appointment availability across different devices.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Data Consistency: The system must maintain 99.9% accuracy in displaying real-time appointment availability, with immediate updates when slots are booked or cancelled.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents scheduling conflicts and ensures users see the most current appointment information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The calendar system must support standard calendar formats (iCal, Google Calendar) for easy integration and synchronization.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows users to integrate healthcare appointments with personal scheduling systems.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Search results must be returned within 3 seconds for up to 500 property listings, with pagination support for large result sets.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive property search functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The search interface must provide clear input validation, suggesting corrections for invalid search criteria and offering helpful error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users refine their search and prevents frustration with unclear search parameters.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The search system must support all specified search criteria (location, area, bedrooms) with precise filtering and sorting options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive property search capabilities matching user requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: User search history and preferences must be encrypted and stored securely, with options to clear search history.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user privacy and search-related personal information.

functionalRequirement: System shall calculate modification charges based on modifying time, date, route, availability, display new fares, and process payments through the payment gateway

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Modification charge calculations must be completed and displayed within 1 second, with real-time fare updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive pricing modifications for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Faultlessness: The modification and pricing calculation system must maintain 99.99% accuracy in fare computations across all modification scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining trust and preventing pricing errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: All payment transactions must be processed using PCI DSS compliant encryption, with secure tokenization of payment information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects financial transactions and user payment details.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The modification interface must clearly display all price changes, additional charges, and provide a step-by-step confirmation process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures transparency in pricing modifications and user understanding.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate a PDF report of all transactions and send a copy to the customer's email address and another copy to the system database for monthly transaction calculation

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: PDF report generation must be completed within 5 seconds for up to 1,000 transactions, with efficient background processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick report generation without system performance degradation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The transaction reporting system must maintain 99.95% uptime, with automatic retry mechanisms for failed email or database transmissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent and reliable transaction record-keeping.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: PDF reports must be encrypted using AES-256, with access controls limiting visibility to authorized personnel only.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive transaction information from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: Transaction reports must be generated in a standardized, machine-readable format supporting easy data extraction and analysis.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Facilitates future reporting, auditing, and business intelligence processes.
